      Sign-in methods

        Email preferences

        Service emails about your account and walkthroughs still arrive, whatever you choose here.

        Finishing, exporting or leaving
        When a walkthrough is finished
        Turn off its sharing under Manage on its card. New visitors are blocked at once; remove the link or embed from your listing too. Copies people already downloaded cannot be recalled.
        What stays
        Your spaces, walkthroughs and review history stay on this account until you ask for removal. A shared walkthrough stays online while your plan is active. When a plan ends, links, embeds and QR codes keep working for 14 days, then go offline until you restart the plan, unless you ask us for a hosting extension for a walkthrough; nothing is deleted, and its card shows the date.
        Download your records

        One file (JSON) that lists each space with its name, category, general location and date, and each walkthrough with its id, status, date, version and whether its link is on. It does not contain the walkthroughs themselves, their videos or stills, view figures, links or embed codes. Videos and stills download from each walkthrough’s card; for a full export of a delivered walkthrough, ask Veylet support.

        Delete your account

        We delete your account, its spaces and its walkthroughs within 30 days and confirm when it is done. When it completes, every shared link and embed stops working. Download your records first, and remove links and embeds from your listings: copies people already downloaded cannot be recalled. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription billed by Apple. What is kept afterwards, and for how long, is in the terms.

        Capture

        First capture? See the steps
        1. Install Veylet Capture on a LiDAR iPhone and sign in with this same email.
        2. Do one practice capture in a space you are allowed to record. The app shows the moves that matter and route checks. An automatic quality check assesses capture quality before confirming the next step.
        3. Save the space here — suburb or city only, no street address — then capture it on the approved route.
        4. Send from the app: it uploads in the background. Check your account for rendering status. The finished walkthrough appears in this space.
        5. Review the walkthrough here, tick that you have the right to share it, then press Approve and share. Anyone with its link can view or forward it.
        Capture approval

        Capturing spaces for clients needs assessment of your device and a practice capture first.
